facts.statement: The only known specimen of Sciurumimus is a single juvenile fossil discovered in a limestone quarry near Painten in Lower Bavaria, Germany.
facts.quote: It is known from a single juvenile specimen representing the type species, Sciurumimus albersdoerferi, which was found in a limestone quarry close to Painten in Lower Bavaria.

facts.statement: Sciurumimus was first announced informally in 2011 but was not formally described and named until 2012 by Rauhut and colleagues.
facts.quote: The Sciurumimus specimen was first announced in an informal presentation by Rauhut and Foth (2011), but not formally described and named until the following year by Rauhut et al. (2012).

facts.statement: The skull of Sciurumimus is proportionally large, measuring 156% of the femur length and longer than the series of cervical vertebrae.
facts.quote: The skull of Sciurumimus is proportionally large, at 156% of the length of the femur and longer than the cervical vertebrae series.

facts.statement: The fossil preserves filamentous plumage at the base of the tail and on other parts of the body.
facts.quote: The fossil preserves filamentous plumage at the tail base and on other parts of the body.

facts.statement: The known specimen of Sciurumimus is a juvenile individual approximately 72 centimeters long with a skull about 8 centimeters long.
facts.quote: El único espécimen conocido de Sciurumimus es un individuo juvenil de unos 72 centímetros de largo y un cráneo de unos 8 centímetros de largo.

facts.statement: Sciurumimus has relatively short and strong forelimbs with three long-toed segments and claws that together represent about 45% of the leg length.
facts.quote: Sciurumimus tiene patas delanteras relativamente cortas y fuertes. Tienen tres eslabones de los dedos largos y garras que juntos representan alrededor del 45% de la longitud de la pierna.

facts.statement: The tail is long and consists of a total of 59 vertebrae.
facts.quote: La cola es larga y consta de un total de 59 vértebras.

facts.statement: Long and dense filament structures give the animal a surface similar to skin and a shaggy appearance.
facts.quote: Las estructuras de filamentos largos y densos le dan una superficie similar a una piel y una apariencia tupida.

facts.statement: Young animals likely ate different food than adults.
facts.quote: Los animales jóvenes probablemente comieron alimentos diferentes a los de los adultos.

facts.statement: Adult Sciurumimus likely reached a body length of 5 meters and possibly exhibited insular dwarfism.
facts.quote: Los animales adultos de Sciurumimus probablemente miden una longitud corporal de 5 metros y posiblemente presentaran el enanismo insular.

facts.statement: Sciurumimus was originally classified as a basal megalosauroid, but later phylogenetic analyses disputed this placement.
facts.quote: Although originally classified as a basal megalosauroid, later phylogenetic analyses dispute this placement.

facts.statement: Foth and colleagues tentatively placed Sciurumimus in Megalosauroidea in 2020, accompanied by Juravenator.
facts.quote: Foth et al. (2020) again placed, albeit tentatively, Sciurumimus in Megalosauroidea, this time accompanied by Juravenator.

facts.statement: In 2024, Andrea Cau recovered Sciurumimus, along with Compsognathus and Scipionyx, within different positions inside Megalosauroidea.
facts.quote: Andrea Cau, in 2024, recovered Sciurumimus, along with Compsognathus and Scipionyx all within different positions within Megalosauroidea.

facts.statement: Sciurumimus is classified within the superfamily Megalosauroidea.
facts.quote: superfamilia: Megalosauroidea

facts.statement: Sciurumimus lived at the end of the Jurassic period, approximately 150 million years ago during the Tithonian stage, in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 150 millones de años durante el Titoniense, en lo que es hoy Europa.

facts.statement: The skull of Sciurumimus is proportionally very large, being 156% of the femur length and longer than the cervical vertebrae series.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Sciurumimus es proporcionalmente grande, al 156% de la longitud del fémur y más largo que la serie de vértebras cervicales.

facts.statement: The first four upper jaw teeth lack serrations, while the remaining 33 to 35 upper teeth are clearly serrated on the back edge and point strongly backward.
facts.quote: Los cuatro primeros dientes de la mandíbula superior no tienen muescas, los restantes 33 a 35 dientes superiores están claramente dentados en la parte posterior y apuntan fuertemente hacia atrás.

facts.statement: Some analyses found Sciurumimus to be a compsognathid, though this position was noted as tentative.
facts.quote: The analysis found Sciurumimus to be a compsognathid, though they noted that this position was tentative.

facts.statement: While most preserved soft tissue likely represents integumentary structures, a small patch of what may be muscle tissue is observed along the rear edge of the tibia.
facts.quote: Aunque la mayor parte del tejido blando conservado en el holotipo Sciurumimus probablemente represente estructuras tegumentarias, se observa un pequeño parche de lo que puede ser tejido muscular a lo largo del borde posterior de la tibia.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen BMMS BK 11 was discovered between 2009 and 2010 during excavations at the Rygol limestone quarries near Painten in southern Germany.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Sciurumimus, BMMS BK 11, se encontró en 2009 o 2010 durante las excavaciones en las canteras de cal de Rygol cerca de Painten en el sur de Alemania.

facts.statement: The fossil belongs to the beckeri zone of the Kimmeridgian stage, a period of the Late Jurassic.
facts.quote: El hallazgo de la capa de piedra caliza Kelheim pertenece a la zona beckeri del Kimmeridgiense, una etapa de la Jurásico Superior.

facts.statement: The fossil is approximately 151 million years old and is considered one of the best-preserved dinosaur fossils in the world.
facts.quote: El fósil tiene alrededor de 151 millones de años y es uno de los fósiles de dinosaurio mejor conservados del mundo.

facts.statement: Fossils dealer Raimund Albersdörfer funded the excavations, and his wife Birgit donated the fossil to the Solnhofen Mayor-Müller Museum as a permanent loan.
facts.quote: El geólogo y comerciante de fósiles Raimund Albersdörfer había financiado las excavaciones, su esposa Birgit, propietaria del fósil, lo informó como bien cultural y lo dejó a la Solnhofen Alcalde-Müller Museum como un préstamo permanente.

facts.statement: An initial phylogenetic analysis suggested Sciurumimus was a primitive member of Megalosauroidea, a clade of large, primitive carnivorous dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Esta clasificación se apoyaba en uno de los tres análisis iniciales llevados a cabo por los científicos que lo describieron.

facts.statement: Two other initial analyses, which the authors considered less well-founded, placed Sciurumimus closer to Monolophosaurus and Avetheropoda, or in an unresolved position between avetheropods and megalosauroids.
facts.quote: Los otros dos análisis, que los autores consideraron como menos fundamentados, hallaron que estaba más cercanamente relacionado con Monolophosaurus y a Avetheropoda, y en una posición sin resolver entre los aveterópodos y los megalosauroideos, respectivamente.

facts.statement: Determining the exact position of Sciurumimus was difficult because the only known specimen is a very young individual.
facts.quote: La posición exacta fue muy difícil de determinar en los varios analizados realizados debido a que el único espécimen conocido es un ejemplar muy joven.

facts.statement: Many researchers criticized the initial study, noting that the data matrices used to connect the new fossil were incomplete and lacked relevant data from several species.
facts.quote: Este estudio inicial fue criticado por muchos investigadores, quienes señalaron que algunos de los análisis anteriores que los científicos usaron para conectar los datos del nuevo fósil estaban incompletos y les faltaban datos relevantes de varias especies.

facts.statement: Other analyses suggested Sciurumimus was an allosauroid or a tetanuran outside of Avetheropoda.
facts.quote: Otros análisis encontraron que era un alosauroide o un tetanurano fuera de Avetheropoda.

facts.statement: Paul placed Sciurumimus as basal among the Maniraptoromorpha in 2016.
facts.quote: Paul en 2016 lo colocó como basal entre los Maniraptoromorpha.

facts.statement: A detailed analysis of supplementary material found Sciurumimus to be a compsognathid, though the authors noted this position was tentative.
facts.quote: El análisis encontró que Sciurumimus era un compsognátido, aunque señalaron que esta posición era tentativa.

facts.statement: Foth et al. tentatively placed Sciurumimus back in Megalosauroidea in 2020, this time accompanied by Juravenator.
facts.quote: Foth y et al. en 2020 colocó nuevamente, aunque tentativamente, Sciurumimus en Megalosauroidea, esta vez acompañado de Juravenator.

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Sciurumimus as Megalosauroidea.
facts.quote: Parent group: Megalosauroidea

facts.statement: Sciurumimus lived during the Kimmeridgian stage, between 152.21 and 149.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Kimmeridgian to Kimmeridgian (152.21 to 149.2 million years ago)

rejected.quote: Sciurumimus ... is an extinct genus of tetanuran theropod from the Late Jurassic Torleite Formation of Germany.
